name: attendance_penalty_tables_reference
query:
-- Penalty system tables (aligned with synckerja-reference mobile types + 2-3-settings hooks).
-- RLS: org-scoped via public.user_organization_ids().

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- penalty_rules
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.penalty_rules (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  rule_type text NOT NULL CHECK (rule_type IN ('late_arrival', 'early_departure', 'no_checkout', 'invalid_location')),
  threshold_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  penalty_amount numeric(12, 2),
  penalty_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deduction' CHECK (penalty_type IN ('deduction', 'warning', 'points')),
  calculation_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed' CHECK (calculation_type IN ('fixed', 'hourly', 'salary_percentage')),
  hourly_rate numeric(12, 2),
  salary_percentage numeric(5, 2),
  max_penalty_per_month numeric(12, 2),
  description text,
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
  applies_to_all boolean DEFAULT true,
  specific_departments uuid[] DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  created_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_penalty_rules_organization_id ON public.penalty_rules (organization_id);

ALTER TABLE public.penalty_rules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "penalty_rules_org" ON public.penalty_rules;
CREATE POLICY "penalty_rules_org"
  ON public.penalty_rules FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- penalty_settings (one row per organization)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.penalty_settings (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  enable_automatic_penalties boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  enable_salary_based_calculation boolean DEFAULT false,
  default_calculation_type text,
  default_hourly_rate numeric(12, 2),
  default_salary_percentage numeric(5, 2),
  grace_settings jsonb,
  holiday_penalty_rules jsonb,
  maximum_daily_penalty numeric(12, 2),
  maximum_monthly_penalty numeric(12, 2),
  minimum_penalty_amount numeric(12, 2),
  notification_settings jsonb,
  penalty_calculation_timezone text,
  penalty_deduction_date integer,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT penalty_settings_organization_id_key UNIQUE (organization_id)
);

ALTER TABLE public.penalty_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "penalty_settings_org" ON public.penalty_settings;
CREATE POLICY "penalty_settings_org"
  ON public.penalty_settings FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- penalty_exemptions
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.penalty_exemptions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  employee_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  penalty_rule_id uuid REFERENCES public.penalty_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  exemption_type text NOT NULL,
  reason text NOT NULL,
  start_date date NOT NULL,
  end_date date,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  conditions jsonb,
  approved_at timestamptz,
  approved_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_penalty_exemptions_organization_id ON public.penalty_exemptions (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_penalty_exemptions_employee_id ON public.penalty_exemptions (employee_id);

ALTER TABLE public.penalty_exemptions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "penalty_exemptions_org" ON public.penalty_exemptions;
CREATE POLICY "penalty_exemptions_org"
  ON public.penalty_exemptions FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- attendance_penalties (FK to attendance_records optional)
-- payroll_periods_id reserved; no FK until payroll_periods exists in project
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.attendance_penalties (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organizations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  employee_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  attendance_record_id uuid REFERENCES public.attendance_records (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  penalty_rule_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.penalty_rules (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  penalty_amount numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  penalty_reason text NOT NULL,
  applied_date date NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_DATE),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'waived', 'appealed')),
  waived_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  waived_at timestamptz,
  waiver_reason text,
  notes text,
  appeal_notes text,
  auto_generated boolean DEFAULT false,
  violation_details jsonb,
  payment_date date,
  payroll_periods_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attendance_penalties_organization_id ON public.attendance_penalties (organization_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attendance_penalties_employee_id ON public.attendance_penalties (employee_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attendance_penalties_applied_date ON public.attendance_penalties (applied_date DESC);

ALTER TABLE public.attendance_penalties ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "attendance_penalties_org" ON public.attendance_penalties;
CREATE POLICY "attendance_penalties_org"
  ON public.attendance_penalties FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (organization_id IN (SELECT public.user_organization_ids()));
